note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. Card A is the original decision and card B the confirmatory decision as supplied; both are drawn at the same size and weight. A hand only moves card B into line beside card A (the arrow marks on their facing edges meet) and a neutral filter strip is laid across the configured rows. The printed results are supplied text: they are never changed, compared or judged, and no doctrine on what a confirmation means is drawn or implied. The calendar marks no date. Brief fields: decisions, grounds, routes (the configured alignment row and its caption), outcomes (the printed results), actorLabels, objectLabels, actionProgress, annotations and finalState are editable.
